jobs.description:
Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!
 

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 
 

 
 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.
 

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.
 

What You’ll Do
 

 
• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
 
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
 
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
 
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
 
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients. 
 

Good to Know You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:
 

 
• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
 
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
 
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
 
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.
 
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

As a Production Team Lead, you will be responsible for the daily production of personalized cell therapies for both clinical and commercial use in a sterile cGMP environment. You will coordinate the different units within the CAR-T process and ensure that all activities are carried out safely and in full compliance with cGMP requirements — while steering and organizing the operations from your office-based workspace, keeping a strong overview of the production flow and acting as the central point of coordination for the team. If you don't have prior leadership experience yet, that is also okay. 
 

What you can expect: 
 

 
• Coordinate and supervise operational units within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Act as the first point of contact for production issues and collaborate closely with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
 
• Serve as a domain expert for Quality and Operations in cGMP environments and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
 
• Manage all quality-related production aspects, including procedures, work instructions, logbooks, transfer forms, batch record review and release, and overall cGMP compliance.
 
• Coordinate quality system activities such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
 
• Ensure proper training of team members and promote a culture of continuous learning.
 
• Drive operational excellence by initiating improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall quality. 

Who we are looking for: 
 

 
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma. 
 
• Experience in people management, or with relatable coordinating activities such as training, coaching, ... .
 
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations; familiarity with Microsoft Office is required, and experience with MES/EBR is a plus.
 
• Strong communication and organizational skills. You don’t need formal leadership experience, but you do show natural leadership qualities.
 
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with strong attention to detail.
 
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

For our client in Beernem, we are looking for an experienced tiler.
 

You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling
 
• A driving licence is required!
 
• You speak fluent Dutch or English
 
• You have a VCA certificate or are willing to obtain one

Do you have a Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences and experience with cell culture? Would you like to contribute to groundbreaking therapies that are changing patients' lives worldwide?
 

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

For our client, a biotech company that is a fast-growing & innovative organization, we are looking for a warehouse associate.
 

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 
 

Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, ...) in a controlled temperature environment.
 

Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies.
 

Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic
 

Fill out the Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for incoming materials including: transport unloading, temperature control, integrity control, administrative paperwork related to following correct procedures.
 

Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment.
 

Work closely together with the Operations and Quality department to support the Production and Lab activities for our start-up site. 
 

Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes.
 

Working in two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to process inbound, picking and outbound activities.
 

Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts.
 

At Legend Biotech in Zwijnaarde, you will have the opportunity to participate in the production of advanced CAR-T cell therapies, an innovative form of cancer treatment. You will work in a highly technological GMP-regulated environment.
 

 
• Working daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment
 
• Ensuring the cleanliness of equipment and production areas 
 

Performing various steps within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including:
 

 
• Cell isolation
 
• Cell selection, activation, and transduction
 
• Cell culture
 
• Aseptic processing
 
• Filling and finishing operations
 
• Cryopreservation 
 

Manufacturing clinical and commercial ATMPs (Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products)
 

 
• Adhering to all applicable quality and safety standards 
 

Performing in-process controls on batch samples while maintaining the highest quality standards
 

Strictly following SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), batch records, and GMP guidelines
 

 
• Recording and managing GMP documentation to ensure compliance and traceability 
 

Supporting environmental monitoring and the maintenance of GMP production areas
 

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Who are you?
 

You are a detail-oriented team player who enjoys working in an innovative manufacturing environment.
 

You have:
 

 
• A Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, or an equivalent field
 
• Initial experience with cell culture
 
• Experience in a GMP environment and/or ATMP manufacturing is a strong asset
 
• Good command of English, both written and spoken
 
• Willingness to work in a shift-based system
 
• A hands-on mentality and strong attention to detail

Job description 

You will be responsible for delivering meat to companies, distribution centers, or supermarkets with a refrigerated trailer.

Possibility of driving shuttles between the customer and distribution centers.

Loading at the processor and 2 to 3 stops per day. Unloading at the dock or using the loading bridge and electric pallet truck.

Working from Monday to Friday.

 

 Requirements 

    
• CE driver's license with a valid C95.
    
• You have initial experience in refrigerated transport.
    
• You are Dutch or speak English well.
    
• Shifts from 10 to 13 hours per day.
    
• Good, open communication with planning/management.

Do you enjoy variety and like to get things done? For a family-run logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for a versatile warehouse worker who can be flexibly deployed across different departments and enjoys taking on a variety of tasks.
 

What will you do?
 

- Assemble wooden crates for shipping large machine parts. 
- Pack parts manually and using machines. 
- Process and register documents and information in the computer system. 
- Support colleagues across different departments where needed.

- You enjoy combining physical work with administrative tasks and can easily switch between the two. 
- You speak and understand English well. 
- You work accurately, are flexible and have a hands-on mentality.

jobs.occupation: Power Electronics and Motor Control Engineer
jobs.description:
Welcome to Traxial (A Magnax Company): Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we are designing the next generation of high-performance, energy-efficient systems. We're looking for a PE & Motor Control Engineer to join our innovative team and play a pivotal role in creating systems that push boundaries in robotics and industry.
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design, develop, and optimize high-efficiency power electronic & motor control systems.
   
 

•  

Create detailed requirements and functional designs for power electronic circuits & motor controllers..
   
 

•  

Perform simulations, testing, and validation to ensure system performance meets all requirements.
   
 

•  

Troubleshoot and resolve issues during the design, prototyping, and manufacturing phases.
   
 

•  

Ensure products are compliant with relevant standards for power drive systems.
   
 

•  

Stay informed about the latest trends and developments in power electronics in robotics & industrial applications.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

A Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Minimum of 3 years of experience in power electronics & circuit design.
   
 

•  

Strong knowledge of inverters and motor controllers.
   
 

•  

Experience with PCB design tools such as Kicad, Altium or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Experience with electronic circuit simulation software such as LTSpice or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Understanding of thermal management and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC).
   
 

•  

Previous experience in model-based design and/or FPGA platforms will be considered a plus.
   
 

•  

A team player with excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.
   
 

•  

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Are you passionate about metal, steel, engineering, welding, overhead cranes, or forklifts?

We are currently looking for several profiles to work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift in Zwevezele.

We are recruiting for the following positions:

• Press brake operators
• Forklift drivers
• Loaders and unloaders
• Overhead crane operators
• Saw machine operators
• General metalworking machine operators

Your profile

• You bring a healthy dose of enthusiasm and motivation.
• You have experience working with machines and a strong interest in technology, or experience operating a forklift.
• You have solid technical insight.
• You have a very good knowledge of Dutch and/or English.
• You are available to work Monday to Friday in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.
Working hours:

• Morning shift: starts at 5:00 or 6:00 AM, depending on the department.
• Afternoon shift: starts at 1:00 or 2:00 PM.
• Night shift: starts on Monday evening at 9:00 or 10:00 PM. On Fridays, the schedule is adjusted so you start and finish earlier, allowing you to begin the weekend sooner.

jobs.occupation: AI Engineer | Create real business impact
jobs.description:
Work at the intersection oftechnology, data, and business, identifying opportunities where AI can create value and turning business needs into solutions.

Ready for a new challenge in AI?Join an international technology company in Brussels and contribute to the development of AI solutions that create real business impact.

 

Our partner, aninternational professional company, is looking for anAI Engineerto join its team and contribute to the design, development, and deployment of AI-powered solutions.
AI Engineer - What's the job about
• Design, develop, and deployAI-powered solutionsaddressing real-world business challenges.
• Develop and integrate solutions based onMachine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs).
• Integrate AI models and services into existing applications, systems, and IT environments.
• Collaborate with IT, data, and business teams to identifyAI and automation opportunitiesacross the organization.
• Develop prototypes and POCs, and transform successful concepts intorobust, scalable, production-ready solutions.
• Work on data pipelines, model evaluation, and the continuous improvement of AI solution performance.
• Contribute to the documentation of AI solutions and the development ofAI and MLOps best practices.
AI Engineer - Who we are looking for
• 2 to 5 years of experience inAI Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, or AI solution development.
• Strong proficiency inPythonand hands-on experience developing AI-powered solutions.
• Solid understanding ofMachine Learning, Generative AI, and LLMs.
• Experience with AI frameworks and tools such asPyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or LangChain.
• Good understanding ofAPIs, cloud architectures, and deployment environments.
• Experience withAWS, Azure, or GCPand/or MLOps technologies is a strong plus.
• Analytical and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to translate business challenges into practical technical solutions.
• Curious, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-changing technological environment.
• Fluent in English and Dutch.

Are you an experienced .NET DevOps Engineer with strong skills in ASP.NET Core and Azure DevOps pipelines ?

We are looking for an experienced Senior .NET DevOps Engineer to join a dynamic platform team working in a large-scale Agile IT environment.

The team works transversally across the organization and focuses on making the Azure Cloud platform accessible, scalable and easy to use for other development teams. You will work in a multidisciplinary team following Agile, Scrum and SAFe methodologies.
Role
• Design, develop and maintain reusable .NET components using C# and ASP.NET Core.
• Design, develop and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD components using C#, PowerShell, YAML pipelines and Bicep.
• Collaborate with developers, testers, architects, Product Owners and Scrum Masters in a SAFe environment.
• Participate in PI Planning and other Agile ceremonies.
• Analyze and resolve technical issues and bugs.
• Perform code reviews and ensure high-quality code through unit and integration testing.
• Create and maintain technical documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing.
• Provide technical leadership, coaching and mentoring to less experienced colleagues.
• Continuously improve development processes, software quality and technical solutions.
• Stay up to date with relevant technologies and industry best practices.
Profile
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role.
• Strong experience with .NET, C# and ASP.NET Core.
• Solid experience with Azure DevOps and Azure Cloud.
• Experience with CI/CD, YAML pipelines, PowerShell and Bicep.
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Strong technical coaching and mentoring abilities.
• Adaptability and a continuous learning mindset
 
Nice to Have
At least 1 year of experience with:

• WCF
• Blazor
• gRPC
• GitHub EnterpriseLanguages
• Dutch or French: Native level
• Second national language (Dutch or French): Basic written and spoken communication
• English: Good comprehension.

Take ownership of scalable web applications, shape technical architecture and build robust solutions with PHP, Symfony & Vue.js.

Our partner is looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer to strengthen its development team.

You will work on scalable web applications, contribute to key architectural decisions and take ownership of technical topics across the stack.

The position combines hands-on development with architecture, code quality and knowledge sharing in a collaborative environment.
Senior Full Stack Engineer | Role
• Design, develop and maintain scalable web applications with PHP & Symfony at the core.
• Contribute to system architecture and solution design, focusing on security, performance, scalability and maintainability.
• Develop APIs and integrations, including asynchronous communication patterns.
• Work across the stack on backend services with PHP/Symfony and frontend features with Vue.js.
• Implement automated testing and collaborate on GitLab CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices.
• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, knowledge sharing and mentoring within the team.
Senior Full Stack Engineer | Profile
• You have 10+ years of experience as a Full Stack or Backend Engineer.
• You have strong expertise in PHP & Symfony and a solid understanding of web architecture, design patterns and best practices.
• You are comfortable with MySQL/PostgreSQL, caching solutions and asynchronous or distributed systems concepts.
• You have experience with GitLab CI/CD, modern DevOps practices and Docker.
• You have experience with automated testing and bring strong problem-solving skills in collaborative, agile environments.
• You communicate confidently in English.
• Knowledge of TypeScript, Vue.js or Python is considered an asset.

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using ROS2
• Integrate and optimize navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion
• Build perception systems using Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization)
• Design and deploy Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decision-making
• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance optimization
• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning
• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands

• You are hands-on and have at least 3 to 5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation
• You have a thorough knowledge of ROS2, C, C  , and Python
• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields:Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization
• Control systems for robotics
• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM)
• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics
• You are comfortable working with hardware and in real-world field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment
• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work
• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments)
• You can communicate fluently in English

Satellit operates a substantial portfolio of mobility assets across multiple European markets and is accelerating its shift toward digital services to improve the customer experience. To support this journey we are hiring a senior Database Administrator to take responsibility for the current database estate, maintain performance, security and availability, and lead the migration from on-premises data centres to a public cloud environment.

Who are you?

Skills & competences:

 
• Conscientiousness
 
• Motivation and positive mindset
 
• Ability to work independently
 
• Quick learning and strong organizational skills
 
• Excellent verbal and written communication
 
• Customer-centric approach
 
• Teamwork
 
• Willingness to ask difficult questions
 
• Professionalism
 
• Transparency and solution orientation

 

Preferred qualifications:

 
• Minimum seven years of hands-on experience administering databases in production environments where availability and reliability are critical, with deep expertise in mainstream commercial relational database systems.
 
• Proven experience designing and operating high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions such as synchronous replication and failover clustering.
 
• Strong proficiency in SQL, including query tuning and execution-plan analysis.
 
• Practical experience deploying and managing database workloads in a public cloud environment, including managed database offerings and cloud-hosted virtual machines.
 
• Experience migrating databases from on-premises infrastructure to cloud platforms is highly desirable.
 
• Familiarity with open-source relational databases is an advantage.
 
• Ability to automate repetitive tasks using scripting or general-purpose programming languages; experience with infrastructure-as-code or CI/CD for database changes is a plus.
 
• Track record of leading database projects such as major version upgrades, consolidation initiatives or security-hardening efforts.
 
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; relevant cloud database or IT service-management certifications are beneficial.
 
• Fluent written and spoken English, plus fluency in either French or Dutch.

What will you do?

 
• Deploy, configure, upgrade, administer, monitor and maintain the organisation's relational databases both on-site and in the cloud.
 
• Define, enforce and document configuration, security and data-integrity standards for databases and related objects; keep operational procedures and technical documentation current.
 
• Design, implement and operate backup, restore and high-availability arrangements, and coordinate regular disaster-recovery exercises.
 
• Assess, plan and execute migration of database workloads to a public cloud platform using managed database services, managed instances or database servers on cloud virtual machines, collaborating with cloud engineers.
 
• Enforce security best practices including least-privilege access, encryption of data at rest and in transit, auditing and patch management.
 
• Act as a primary responder and escalation point for database incidents and service requests, aiming to minimise downtime and service impact.
 
• Carry out root-cause investigations for database issues and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
 
• Review and advise on database schemas and design changes with development teams to ensure scalability, maintainability and security.
 
• Continuously monitor performance and resource usage, perform query and index optimisation, and...

As a Logistics Administrative Officer, you will support the cross-dock department, where incoming shipments are received, processed and sorted according to their final destination. You play a crucial role in ensuring smooth administrative processing and accurate shipment follow-up.
